items_flat.title_en: Minnesota AI nudification ban takes effect after judge denies xAI TRO
items_flat.title_zh: 明尼蘇達州AI裸化禁令生效，法官駁回xAI緊急禁制令
items_flat.summary_en: Minnesota’s first-in-the-nation law (HF 1606) banning AI “nudification” tools that generate non-consensual intimate imagery of real people took effect on 1 August 2026 after a federal judge denied xAI’s request for a temporary restraining order on 31 July. The statute carries civil penalties of up to $500,000 per violation; xAI’s First Amendment lawsuit continues with a preliminary-injunction hearing set for 19 August.
items_flat.summary_zh: 明尼蘇達州首部禁止AI「裸化」工具（生成真實人物非自願親密影像）的法律（HF 1606）於2026年8月1日正式生效。此前聯邦法官於7月31日駁回xAI的臨時限制令請求。該法最高可處每張影像50萬美元民事罰款；xAI的憲法訴訟仍持續，初步禁制令聽證會訂於8月19日。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an early concrete test of state-level regulation of generative image models. It raises practical compliance questions for national platforms and leaves open whether the law will survive First Amendment scrutiny or prompt similar statutes elsewhere.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是州層級針對生成式影像模型監管的早期實質案例。它對全國性平台提出實際合規問題，並留下該法是否能通過憲法審查、或引發其他州跟進立法的不確定性。
items_flat.quote: Minnesota’s landmark law banning the use of nudification technology will go into effect tomorrow as planned. These nudification apps, including Grok Imagine, have been used to generate child sexual abuse materials and harass people in the vilest ways imaginable.
items_flat.quote_zh: 明尼蘇達州具里程碑意義的裸化技術禁令將如期於明日生效。這些裸化應用（包括Grok Imagine）已被用來生成兒童性虐待材料，並以最惡劣的方式騷擾他人。

items_flat.title_en: Elon Musk claims Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 on speed and cost
items_flat.title_zh: Elon Musk 聲稱 Grok 4.5 在速度與成本上為帕累托最優
items_flat.summary_en: On 1 August 2026 Elon Musk posted that “Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 when considering speed & cost,” quoting independent testing that ranked it the best frontier model under those constraints. The claim accompanies ongoing public promotion of Grok Build, the company’s agentic CLI tool powered by Grok 4.5.
items_flat.summary_zh: 2026年8月1日，Elon Musk在X上發文稱「Grok 4.5在考慮速度與成本時是帕累托#1」，並引用獨立測試將其評為該約束下最佳前沿模型。此說法伴隨持續推廣由Grok 4.5驅動的代理式CLI工具Grok Build。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public Pareto claims keep competitive pressure on pricing and latency benchmarks, but independent third-party verification of the exact trade-off surface remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開的帕累托主張持續對價格與延遲基準施加競爭壓力，但對精確權衡曲面的獨立第三方驗證仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.5 is Pareto #1 when considering speed & cost
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.5 在考慮速度與成本時是帕累托#1

brief_en: Quiet period for major official announcements from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind or Meta in the last 12 hours. Activity centered on xAI: Elon Musk claimed Grok 4.5 is Pareto-optimal on speed and cost, while Minnesota’s first-in-nation AI nudification ban took effect after a judge denied xAI’s TRO.
brief_zh: 過去12小時OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Meta無重大官方公告。焦點在xAI：Elon Musk稱Grok 4.5在速度與成本上達帕累托最優，明尼蘇達州首部AI裸化禁令在法院駁回xAI緊急禁制令後正式生效。
